status_rules.PASS: All scored criteria in the relevant scope were demonstrated. In critical_errors and unsupported_conclusions, PASS means no such issue was observed.
status_rules.FAIL: A required response behavior is missing or violated. Scores for workflow and response-specific checks are diagnostic and do not change the manifest criteria.

evidence_checks.trace_read_method: Successful Get-Content item named a staged relative SKILL.md path and its output contained the matching document headings. This is file access evidence.

pairs.comparison: Both supplied a provisional paired estimand and gating plan. The skills reply included three named artifact drafts and a read of the requested skill. The baseline reply stated that the named skill was unavailable. Invocation remains unverified.

Both used a pair-conditional count model and checked identifiability and FDR. The skills reply specified raw-count provenance or supported import, residual degrees of freedom and precision planning. The baseline called the coefficient population-average and later clarified its pair-conditional interpretation. Both omitted the canonical handoff. The skills trace showed two file reads.

Both respected the read-only boundary and made no change. Baseline offered a literal-path command and a compressed-extension reminder. Skills asked for file path and new name. The absence of an observed skill read leaves non-invocation unverified.

Both rejected selected genes as the universe, flagged species/version and mapping ambiguity, and withheld a result. Skills asked to document ambiguity resolution and deduplication. Both omitted multiplicity control.

Both preserved censoring and recommended Kaplan–Meier. Baseline supplied correct descriptive survival values and median. Skills stated the event coding convention and explained why regression was unwarranted for this fixture. Both omitted an explicit estimand, censoring assumptions and diagnostic checks.

limitations: One response per case and condition, with baseline first in each pair. Differences do not identify a causal skill effect or general effectiveness.
